sprache.hinweis: Recipes you added yourself are not translated – they stay exactly as you wrote them.

starter.einleitung: Three packs, each one added or removed on its own. Anything already in your cookbook is skipped – no duplicates.
starter.entferntHinweis: Only recipes from this pack that you have not changed, never cooked and not published will be removed. Everything else stays.

uebersprungen.one: {anzahl} was already there and was skipped.
uebersprungen.other: {anzahl} were already there and were skipped.

starter.fussnote: Imported recipes are marked with their source icon in the recipe list. Only untouched, never cooked and unpublished recipes are removed – your own work is never lost.
